card.name: Start of discontinue/discontinuation
card.fires_on: The first piece "Dis" of the words discontinue, discontinuation and discontinued in drug labels. It appears in dosing tables, headings and instructions about stopping a drug.

modes.label: Dis- in stop-treatment instructions
modes.description: "Dis" starts discontinue after a dose-reduction or toxicity condition in a dosing table.
modes.example: /mm 3 with bleeding 50% of previous dose Recurrent Grade 3 or 4 myelosuppression after 2 dose reductions<< Dis>>continue Non-hematologic toxicity Any Grade

modes.label: Dis- in headings and noun forms
modes.description: "Dis" starts discontinuation in section titles or phrases about stopping therapy.
modes.example: 5.1 Increased Risk of Thrombotic Events after Premature<< Dis>>continuation Premature discontinuation of any

card.writes: It pushes toward odd word-ending pieces and away from population words, which says little about the next word.
card.plain: It marks the start of the word discontinue, as in instructions to stop a drug.
